slides.title: Subject-verb agreement: ==ignore== the middle of the sentence
slides.hand: the subject is never where they want you to look

slides.title: Cross out the prepositional phrase
slides.body: The subject of a sentence never lives inside a prepositional phrase. Cross the phrase out, read what's left, and the verb picks itself.

slides.stem: The collection of rare paintings ______ on display until March.
slides.prompt: The SAT put a plural noun right next to the blank on purpose. Comment yours.

slides.title: C — is
slides.body: The subject is *collection* — singular. "Of rare paintings" is the distractor parked next to the blank. Cross it out: "The collection... is on display."
